theme: The hidden cost of coordinating your event alone

linkedin.text:
Hidden cost of DIY corporate event management most HR and marketing leaders don't calculate upfront:

→ 40+ hours of internal coordination per event
→ 4-6 separate vendor contracts to manage
→ Zero single point of accountability when something breaks

The budget line looks leaner. The actual cost — in time, risk, and your team's bandwidth — rarely does.

After 1,500+ events delivered across 130+ destinations, the pattern is consistent: companies that centralize production under one experienced partner spend less time managing and more time leading the room.

If you're scoping a conference, incentive trip, or large-scale retreat and want a straight conversation about scope and budget — DM me directly. No deck, just a real discussion.
